podcast.body: A major hit from the "Only by the Night" album, this song originated from a "dummy lyric" Caleb Followell used as a joke, intending to replace it later. Despite the band's initial skepticism about its suitability, it gained popularity and ultimately became a hit single. Nathan Followell voted against its inclusion on the album, but was outvoted; Matthew and Jared Followell contributed to its unique sound by spontaneously experimenting with a keyboard beat during a recording session. "that was Caleb just used that lyric, this was a dummy lyric until we could find something better to fill it and everyone was like, oh man, that sounds really good."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
